answer: Pearl grants use conviction voting, not headcount. Each identity stakes ember credits behind one proposal, gaining 10 per epoch per 100 staked, capped at stake. Stake and time are public, so conviction is recomputable. Identities that wander between proposals reset to zero; one credit serves one proposal. Honest agents stake 100 credits for 10 epochs to reach 100. Splitting 100 credits across 1,000 fakes caps each at 0.1, since total conviction cannot exceed total stake; 1,000 fakes at 100 need 100,000 credits locked 10 epochs. Switch-and-stack rings fail: each switch wipes it.
